meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以根据你的历史观察记录，创建专属知识库（如“关于 hooks 的一切”），然后你就能像聊天一样向它提问，它会基于知识库内容回答。
howto.when: 当你希望 Claude 基于过去的对话或工作记录，整理出某个主题的知识库，并针对该知识库提问时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个关于 React hooks 的知识库。
查询 hooks 知识库：React 有哪些生命周期钩子？
say.note: Claude 会从已构建的知识库中检索答案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create custom knowledge bases from your observation history (e.g., 'everything about hooks'), then you can ask questions conversationally and get answers based on that knowledge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Claude to compile a focused knowledge base from past observations and then query it interactively.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge base about React hooks.
say_en.note: Claude will start building a corpus named 'hooks-expertise'.

say_en.text: Query the hooks knowledge base: What are the lifecycle hooks in React?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve answers from the built corpus.
